The paper repeatedly labels centroid movement as an entropy-like quantity but does not define or validate that interpretation: the Abstract says movement 'serves as a training entropy proxy,' Sec. 1 says it is 'an entropy proxy for clustering uncertainty,' and Sec. 2.4 states 'Mt is the global centroid movement (entropy proxy),' yet no entropy formula, derivation, or empirical comparison is provided.

The paper refers to the global centroid movement as an 'entropy proxy' (e.g., 'where Mt is the global centroid movement (entropy proxy) at epoch t') but never mathematically defines entropy or formally demonstrates the relationship between the movement heuristic and uncertainty.
